require: хотя бы одно обстоятельство (времени, места, причины или образа действия)

patterns.generation_hint: Используй глаголы привычек и рутины. Добавь обстоятельство, которое объясняет, когда/где/как часто это происходит.
examples: My brother commutes to work by train three times a week.
She teaches English literature at university and also volunteers at a local library.
Most people in my neighbourhood organize community events whenever they have free time.

patterns.generation_hint: Добавь причину, почему действие не происходит.
examples: My colleague doesn't support the new company policy because it doesn't fit our schedule.
They don't like the idea of working from home because they prefer face-to-face communication.

patterns.generation_hint: Опиши действие сейчас и добавь параллельное действие.

while + parallel action: while their children are playing outside
while waiting for a client call

examples: My sister is preparing a presentation for tomorrow's meeting while listening to music.
The team is discussing a project that needs to be finished by Friday.

patterns.generation_hint: Опиши временную ситуацию и добавь контраст.
examples: I am staying at my friend's place this week, but usually I work from home.
They are living with their grandparents for the summer, but they usually spend summers at the seaside.

patterns.generation_hint: Добавь временной период и результат.
examples: I have been to several countries in Europe since I finished university, so I feel much more confident now.
She has learned a new language for three months and it has changed her daily routine completely.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй never/ever для опыта. Добавь контраст.

but + desire: but I have always wanted to try it
but he hopes to go there next year
but they are planning to do it soon
but she has been dreaming about it for years

examples: I have never tried Japanese food, but I have always wanted to try it.
They have never seen a live concert of their favourite band, but they are planning to do it soon.

patterns.generation_hint: Подчеркни длительность и результат.
examples: I have been working on a new project for the marketing department since last Monday, and I think I am making progress.
She has been studying English grammar for more than two hours, so she needs a short break.

patterns.generation_hint: Добавь обстоятельство времени и причину.
examples: I visited a small exhibition of local artists last weekend because I needed a break from work.
They organized a surprise party for our colleague on Friday evening because she was leaving the company.

patterns.generation_hint: Добавь контраст или причину.

although + contrast: although I had planned to do it
although we had discussed it before

examples: I didn't watch the film that everyone was talking about, although I had planned to do it.
They didn't finish the report on time, although they had enough time.

patterns.generation_hint: Опиши фоновое действие и прерывающее событие.
examples: I was cooking dinner for the whole family when the phone rang, so I had to stop and answer.
They were preparing a presentation for the next day when the lights went out, and everything became chaotic for a moment.

patterns.generation_hint: Опиши два одновременных или последовательных действия в прошлом.
examples: While I was driving home, I realized that we had made a mistake, so I called my colleagues immediately.
While she was talking to an important client, she decided to change our strategy because the situation had changed.

patterns.generation_hint: Подчеркни хронологию: одно действие раньше другого.

before + S + V2: before my boss asked me about it
before we left for the airport

examples: I had finished my part of the project before the deadline arrived, so I felt quite confident.
They had booked the tickets for the concert before we left for the airport, so everything went smoothly.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй will для решений, обещаний и предсказаний.
examples: I will help you with your presentation if I have enough time because I want to support you.
We will send all the necessary documents by Friday if everything goes according to plan.

patterns.pattern: [S] + am/is/are + going to + [V1] + [complex object] + [optional: because + reason]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй going to для планов и намерений.
examples: I am going to start a new online course on digital marketing because I want to improve my career prospects.
We are going to visit my relatives in another city because we haven't seen each other for a long time.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй для запланированных встреч и договорённостей.
examples: I am meeting an important client tomorrow at 10 am with our marketing team.
They are attending a conference on innovation next Thursday with a potential investor.

subtopics.name: Obligation and Necessity (must, have to, should)

patterns.generation_hint: Используй must для сильных личных обязательств.
examples: I must finish this report before the end of the day because the deadline is very close.
Every employee must follow the safety instructions carefully because it's required by law.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй have to для внешних обязательств.
examples: My colleague has to attend weekly team meetings every Monday morning.
We have to submit financial reports every month before the 5th.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй should для советов и рекомендаций.
examples: You should consider this opportunity seriously if you want to grow professionally.
People should take a short break after work if they feel stressed or tired.

subtopics.name: Permission and Probability (can, could, may, might)

patterns.generation_hint: Используй can для способности и разрешения, could — для вежливых просьб.

complex object: your laptop for a few minutes
the main idea in simple words

examples: I can help you with this task if you need any support.
She could explain the main idea in simple words if you have any questions.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй may/might для вероятности.
examples: I might be late for the meeting, but I'm not sure yet.
The situation may change in the next few days, but it depends on many factors.

subtopics.name: Prohibition and Lack of Necessity (mustn't, don't have to)

patterns.generation_hint: Используй mustn't для строгих запретов.
examples: You mustn't touch the equipment without permission because it can be dangerous.
Visitors mustn't use mobile phones during the exam because it disturbs other people.

patterns.pattern: [S] + don't/doesn't + have to + [V1] + [complex object] + [optional: but + alternative]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй don't have to для отсутствия необходимости.
examples: I don't have to come to the office every day, but I can if I want to.
She doesn't have to prepare a long presentation, but it's still a good idea to be ready.

patterns.pattern: If + [S] + [Present Simple] + [complex object], [S] + will + [V1] + [complex object] + [optional: result]
patterns.generation_hint: Опиши реальную будущую ситуацию.

complex object (condition): a better solution to this problem
complex object (result): all our colleagues to the party

examples: If I finish this project on time, I will celebrate with my closest friends, so it will be a great end of the year.
If we save enough money for the trip, we will go to Italy for two weeks and we will finally relax.

patterns.pattern: If + [S] + [Past Simple] + [complex object], [S] + would + [V1] + [complex object] + [optional: reason/result]
patterns.generation_hint: Опиши гипотетическую ситуацию.

complex object (condition): more free time during the week
a million dollars in the lottery
complex object (result): around the world for a year

examples: If I had more free time during the week, I would travel around the world for a year because it would be a dream come true.
If she lived closer to the city centre, she would walk to work every morning because it would save her a lot of time.

patterns.generation_hint: Опиши общеизвестные факты или процессы.
examples: English is spoken by millions of people all over the world.
The reports are prepared by the research department at the end of each quarter.

patterns.generation_hint: Опиши исторические события или завершённые процессы.
examples: The bridge was designed by a famous architect at the end of the 19th century.
The song was recorded by a popular singer in 1995.

patterns.generation_hint: Передай чужую речь с изменением времён.

complex object: a lot of work to do

examples: He said that he was very tired after the trip the day before.
She said she would come back the following week because she had a lot of work to do.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй герундий после глаголов предпочтения.
examples: I enjoy reading books about history and culture in the evening after work.
My friend loves traveling to new countries with a small backpack during the summer holidays.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй инфинитив после глаголов решения и намерения.
examples: I have decided to improve my English for career purposes because I want to feel more confident.
She hopes to visit her relatives in another country next summer.

patterns.generation_hint: Объедини два предложения в одно с помощью relative clause.

complex object: me the most in my career

examples: The person who helped me the most in my career was my first manager, and I will never forget it.
The book which changed my way of thinking is called 'Atomic Habits', and I often recommend it to others.

patterns.pattern: [S] + usually + [V1] + [complex object], but + right now + [S] + am/is/are + [V-ing] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Сравни привычное действие с тем, что происходит прямо сейчас.
examples: I usually work from the office in the city centre, but right now I am working from a small café near my house.
She usually commutes by public transport, but right now she is driving to a meeting outside the city.

patterns.pattern: [S] + [V1] + [complex object] + [frequency], but this week + [S] + am/is/are + [V-ing] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Сравни обычную рутину с временным изменением.
examples: I go to the gym every Monday and Wednesday, but this week I am going to a different gym near my new apartment.
They usually have lunch with colleagues every day, but this week they are having lunch alone because everyone is on holiday.

patterns.pattern: [S] + have/has + [V3] + [complex object] + [optional: result], and + [S] + [V2] + [complex object] + [finished time]
patterns.generation_hint: Покажи разницу: Present Perfect — результат важен сейчас, Past Simple — конкретное время.
examples: I have read this book about productivity and it has changed my daily routine, but I didn't really understand it when I read the same book last year.
She has visited several countries in Asia and has learned a lot from them, but the experience was completely different when she visited Japan in 2019.

patterns.pattern: Have/Has + [S] + ever + [V3] + [complex object]? — Yes, [S] + [V2] + [complex object] + [finished time]
patterns.generation_hint: Задай вопрос об опыте и дай ответ с конкретным временем.
examples: Have you ever been to an English-speaking country? — Yes, I went to London when I was a student.
Has your sister ever tried sushi? — Yes, she tried sushi for the first time during our trip in 2021.

subtopics.name: Present Simple for Timetables and Schedules

patterns.generation_hint: Используй Present Simple для расписаний (поезда, самолёты, встречи по графику).
examples: The train leaves at 7:30 in the morning according to the timetable, so I need to leave home early.
The conference takes place at the end of the month as planned, so I need to book my tickets today.

patterns.generation_hint: Передай общий вопрос (yes/no) в косвенной речи.

complex object: come to the meeting in person
more time to complete the task

examples: He asked me if I was available for a short call.
My colleague asked his manager whether they needed more time to complete the task.

patterns.generation_hint: Передай специальный вопрос (what/where/when/why/how).
examples: She asked me where I lived before moving to this city.
The client asked us how we planned to organize the event.

patterns.generation_hint: Передай просьбу или приказ.

complex object: the documents by the end of the day
the client as soon as possible

examples: The manager told me to send the documents by the end of the day because the deadline was close.
She asked her colleague to check all the details carefully because the client was waiting.

patterns.generation_hint: Передай отрицательную просьбу или запрет.
examples: He told me not to be late for the meeting because it was against the rules.
My parents asked us not to leave the door open because the security system was on.

subtopics.name: The more... the better / less than

patterns.pattern: The more + [S] + [V1] + [complex object], the more + [S] + [V1] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй конструкцию 'the more... the more' для пропорциональной зависимости.

complex object (second): your chances in the job market

examples: The more you practice a foreign language, the more confident you become in real conversations.
The more we travel to new places, the more open-minded we feel.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'less than' для сравнения в обратную сторону.
examples: This option is less expensive than the previous one, but it still has its advantages.
The new system is less complicated than what I expected, but it requires more attention.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй Present Perfect Passive для результата, который важен сейчас.
examples: The project has been completed by the whole team recently.
All the documents have been signed by the director this month.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй Future Passive для будущих событий, где важно действие, а не исполнитель.
examples: The new office will be opened by the CEO next month.
The results will be announced by the marketing team at the end of the year.

subtopics.name: Relative Clauses with where and whose

patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'where' для описания места.
examples: The city where I spent my childhood has become a popular tourist destination.
The café where we meet to relax after work is my favourite spot in the city.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'whose' для принадлежности.

complex object: me a lot in my career

examples: The colleague whose advice helped me a lot in my career is now my closest friend, and I will always be grateful to him.
The writer whose books changed my way of thinking is called Haruki Murakami, and I often recommend them to my friends.
